column1: # What enforces each requirement in this repository's specs (0020-spec-format FR-011 – FR-014).
# mechanism: check | gate | review | none. by: "<repo>: <command>" for check and gate, the defining requirement for review, "-" for none.

column4: note
scope; superseding the earlier environment is a decision, not a check
doctor reports python, uv and the distribution; tests run the install in fresh Debian and Ubuntu containers
tests run the launcher from another directory, through absolute and relative links, and without uv
a test reads pyproject.toml and the presence of uv.lock; the core's imports are parsed
tests run install.sh against a local remote: clone, link, doctor, a repeat, a clone with edits, a missing prerequisite
the install tests use WS_HOST_URL and WS_HOST_HOME
tests run in a temporary HOME and read the paths from the XDG variables
tests parse the configuration, refuse a secrets file others can read, and keep secrets out of doctor and context
WORKSPACES_HOME is exported when programs are run, which arrives with the commands that run them
finds conflicts and module-level third-party imports; tests cover both
tests run every command that takes no required argument in three renderings
tests run doctor against a malformed configuration, a loose secrets file and a registry conflict
tests run the sections, an unknown section, and a section that could not run
test is itself the runner; its result fails when no test ran
tests check the first line of text renderings and that actions print as one line or not at all
tests check what is logged, with its surface, and that a read is not
the listing tests resolve full, short and ambiguous names
tests read the person's list and a cloned repository's file, to any depth, ignore a malformed entry, and need no trust
tests run repo list and repo status against real clones: ahead, behind, dirty, branch
tests clone into the layout, trust nothing, and take --dry-run
tests run a failed clone, a clone of a private repository without sign-in (git's own reason and the auth action), and one failure among several
tests clone a repository only another's file names and leave it untrusted
tests spy on every git call: no pull, rebase, stash, reset or checkout, and merge only with --ff-only
tests leave dirty, diverged, no-upstream, detached, mid-rebase and unpushed-conflicting repositories exactly as they were (HEAD, index, status, no stash, no rebase or merge state) with exit 0
tests read the plain-language reason of each skip and the note on unpushed work
tests read each outcome: updated with a count, current, skipped, failed
tests run auth status and auth new against a fake gh and glab: signed in or out, the streamed code and address, a failed login, a missing program (exit 3)
tests grant and revoke trust through the relative link, an organization in the person's configuration, and a name collision
tests list a repository named by a trusted one as untrusted and ignore a repository's own WS_HOST_TRUSTED, with doctor saying so
tests confirm a decision only from a terminal answer or the editor's confirmation, refuse it otherwise, keep it off MCP, and list what --trust trusts
tests record the commit and make doctor warn, not fail, when a trusted repository's kits changed
tests run workspace advance end to end: steps, a repeat that changes nothing, past a failure, dry run, status
tests check doctor recommends pull.ff only, never applies it, and workspace set applies it on request
tests check a clone's ignored and untracked state and the person's git configuration after advance
tests run kit list, show and an unknown kit, and that actions print as one line
tests check kit add is setup and cli only, says it will use sudo before running, uses sudo -n without a terminal and says what to run when refused
tests resolve a|b names and report a package the distribution lacks without stopping the install
tests and the container runs end with the kit's programs, versions and functional checks
tests run the package installer against a stand-in apt-get, installing only what is missing, as root without sudo
tests run the download installer with real archives: verification, a wrong checksum, atomic current, links, a repeat, an older version kept, a failed step, unsafe paths
tests check --dry-run and --offline fetch and install nothing and exit 3 naming the download
tests check base's programs and the userland, WebP and Chromium checks; the container runs on Debian and Ubuntu
tests check press's packages; the container runs the lualatex check on Debian and Ubuntu
tests check rust's version and download; the container runs the rustc check and a cargo build of a reqwest and rustls crate
tests check every download's checksum form, address template and architecture
tests run workspace advance over declared kits (see 0002 FR-016); a declared kit that is unknown is reported
tests check doctor says a trusted repository's kits are not loaded yet
